description: Source code for an Android Fragment that manages camera preview, capture, and related functionalities using Camera2 API.

classes.name: Camera2BasicFragment
classes.description: Main fragment class managing camera preview, capture, and permissions.

classes.name: ImageSaver
classes.description: Runnable class to save captured JPEG images to file.

classes.name: CompareSizesByArea
classes.description: Comparator for comparing Size objects based on their area.

classes.name: ConfirmationDialog
classes.description: DialogFragment to confirm camera permission requests.

methods.name: chooseOptimalSize
methods.description: Selects the best camera preview size based on constraints.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of Camera2BasicFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes view components and sets click listeners.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes file for saving images.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts background thread and opens camera if view is available.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Closes camera and stops background thread.

methods.name: requestCameraPermission
methods.description: Requests camera permission from user.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles user's response to permission request.

methods.name: setUpCameraOutputs
methods.description: Configures camera outputs and preview size.

methods.name: openCamera
methods.description: Opens camera device with specified size.

methods.name: closeCamera
methods.description: Closes camera device and related resources.

methods.name: startBackgroundThread
methods.description: Starts background thread for camera operations.

methods.name: stopBackgroundThread
methods.description: Stops background thread.

methods.name: createCameraPreviewSession
methods.description: Creates camera preview session.

methods.name: configureTransform
methods.description: Adjusts TextureView transformation based on device rotation.

methods.name: takePicture
methods.description: Initiates picture capture sequence.

methods.name: lockFocus
methods.description: Locks camera focus before capturing.

methods.name: runPrecaptureSequence
methods.description: Runs auto-exposure precapture sequence.

methods.name: captureStillPicture
methods.description: Captures a still image and saves to file.

methods.name: getOrientation
methods.description: Calculates JPEG orientation based on device rotation.

methods.name: unlockFocus
methods.description: Resets focus lock after capturing.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays a toast message on UI thread.

methods.name: setAutoFlash
methods.description: Enables auto flash if supported.
